set_desc: Set intensity, light color, indirect and volumetric intensity, lower-hemisphere color and occlusion of a SkyLight actor found by label or name, through the component's setters, which update its rendering state; set_properties writes any other field. Only supplied fields change, in one undo step, and all are read back. light_color and lower_hemisphere_color are linear [R,G,B(,A)]; occlusion_tint is [R,G,B(,A)] in whole 0-255 bytes. A Static SkyLight is refused, since its setters change nothing (make it Stationary or Movable first), and so is a malformed field; nothing changes then. Not saved.
get_desc: Read the intensity, color and occlusion settings of a SkyLight actor's component, found by label or name in the editor world, under the snake_case names set_sky_light_properties takes. A curated view; get_properties (internal names only) reads any other UPROPERTY on it.
get_retired: get_properties - object_path="<actor>.SkyLightComponent", property_names=["Intensity","LightColor","Contrast",...], or get_component_properties for all of them

reader_comment: SetLightColor stores LightColor as an sRGB FColor, so it reads back as 0-255 bytes.

fields.desc: Optional [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A] occlusion tint, each a whole number from 0 to 255 (FColor; A defaults to 255).
